name: Sparklers
description: Electric, colour, green and red sparklers from 7 cm up to 75 cm, plus the twinkling stars. The safest first cracker for a child and the one that photographs best.

name: Flower Pots
description: Ground fountains from the everyday Big pot up to the Monster Super Deluxe. Steady columns of gold, colour and crackling silver with almost no smoke.

name: Aerial Shots
description: Repeating cakes from 7 shots to 504. One fuse, one ignition, and a complete choreographed sequence that runs itself.

name: Fancy Single Shots
description: Single-shot tubes from 2 inch up to 6½ inch. Each one puts a single shell up and opens it cleanly — the way to punctuate a show rather than fill it.

name: Ground Chakkars
description: Paper and wire chakkars that whirl into a disc of colour, plus the spinners that lift off the ground entirely.

name: One Sound & Bijili
description: Kuruvi, Lakshmi, Bahubali and the Bijili packs. Single-report crackers in every size, all tested under the 125 dB PESO ceiling.

name: Garland Crackers
description: Chorsa, Giant, Deluxe and the Wala garlands from 100 up to 10,000 sounds. Hung from a pole, lit once, and left to run.

name: Bombs & Nattu Vedi
tagline: For the ones who want the boom
description: Bullets, atom bombs, the King of Kings, and the hand-tied paper bombs from a quarter kilo to a full one. Open ground only.

name: Kids Zone
description: Butterflies, helicopters, match-box crackers, cap guns and pop-pops. Low noise, low flame and endlessly entertaining.

name: Gift Boxes
description: Assortment boxes from 20 items to 70, hand-packed with a printed cracker list inside the lid. The default answer for office gifting.

name: Family Packs
description: Our largest assortments — 3000 to 10000 — built to cover a full family Diwali without a second trip to the shop.

name: 2026 New Arrivals
description: Twenty-nine items new to the 2026 list — peacocks, colour smoke, the water queen, and a row of novelties that were not here last season.
